title: Stock Profit
difficulty: Easy
position: 5
complexity: O(n)
=== statement
You know a stock's price for each of the next `n` days. Buy one share on one day and sell it on a later day. What is the largest profit you can make? If every trade loses money, do not trade: the profit is 0.
=== input
The first line has `n`. The second line has the `n` prices, in order of days.
=== output
Print the largest profit.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 131072
1 <= price <= 10^6
=== sample
6
7 1 5 3 6 4
--- expected
5
=== sample
5
7 6 4 3 1
--- expected
0
